cards.def:
The introductory statement that outlines a constitution's purpose and values.
हिंदी: प्रस्तावना
examples: The Preamble declares India a sovereign republic.
The Preamble reflects the will of the people.
Courts use the Preamble to interpret laws.
The Preamble promises justice and liberty.

cards.def:
A system of government in which the legislature comprises two separate houses.
हिंदी: द्विसदनीय व्यवस्था
examples: Bicameralism provides a system of checks and balances within parliament.
The Indian Parliament practices bicameralism with the Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha.
Bicameralism ensures that states have representation at the federal level.
Critics argue that bicameralism can delay the passage of urgent legislation.

cards.def:
The principle that the state treats all religions equally.
हिंदी: धर्मनिरपेक्षता
examples: Secularism is a basic feature of the Constitution.
The state cannot favor one religion.

cards.def:
A system dividing power between central and state governments.
हिंदी: संघवाद
examples: Federalism distributes power between Centre and States.

cards.def:
A state where the head is elected, not a hereditary monarch.
हिंदी: गणराज्य
examples: India is a republic with an elected President.

cards.def:
Basic rights guaranteed to citizens by the Constitution.
हिंदी: मौलिक अधिकार
examples: Fundamental Rights can be enforced in court.

cards.def:
Guidelines for government policy aimed at social welfare.
हिंदी: नीति-निर्देशक सिद्धांत
examples: Directive Principles aim at social justice.

cards.def:
Moral obligations of citizens toward the nation.
हिंदी: मौलिक कर्तव्य
examples: Respecting the Constitution is a duty.
Protecting the environment is a duty.

cards.def:
The principle that certain core features cannot be altered.
हिंदी: मूल ढाँचा सिद्धांत
examples: The Basic Structure Doctrine emerged in Kesavananda case.

cards.def:
The power of courts to examine laws for constitutionality.
हिंदी: न्यायिक समीक्षा
examples: Judicial Review upholds the rule of law.
Courts use Judicial Review to protect rights.

cards.def:
Division of authority among legislature, executive, and judiciary.
हिंदी: शक्तियों का पृथक्करण

The branch that makes laws.
हिंदी: विधायिका
examples: The legislature debates and passes bills.

cards.def:
The branch that implements laws and runs administration.
हिंदी: कार्यपालिका
examples: The executive is accountable to the legislature.
The executive includes the President and Council of Ministers.
Executive power must be used lawfully.

cards.def:
The branch that interprets laws and delivers justice.
हिंदी: न्यायपालिका

The principle that everyone is equal before the law.
हिंदी: विधि का शासन
examples: Rule of Law prevents arbitrary power.
No one is above the Rule of Law.
Rule of Law protects the weak.

cards.def:
Fair legal procedures that protect individual rights.
हिंदी: उचित विधि-प्रक्रिया
examples: Due Process protects against arbitrary arrest.
Due Process balances state and citizen.
Due Process is guaranteed by Article 21.

cards.def:
The principle that all persons are subject to the same laws.
हिंदी: विधि के समक्ष समानता
examples: Equality Before Law is guaranteed by Article 14.
Equality Before Law applies to all citizens.

cards.def:
The right to express opinions without censorship.
हिंदी: अभिव्यक्ति की स्वतंत्रता
examples: Freedom of Speech is guaranteed by Article 19.
Freedom of Speech has reasonable restrictions.

cards.def:
The right to live with dignity and liberty.
हिंदी: जीवन का अधिकार
examples: Right to Life is protected by Article 21.
Right to Life covers health and environment.
Right to Life is the most sacred right.

cards.def:
The right to equal treatment and opportunity.
हिंदी: समता का अधिकार
examples: Right to Equality is guaranteed by Articles 14–18.
Right to Equality bans caste discrimination.
Right to Equality promotes social justice.
Right to Equality ensures equal opportunity.

cards.def:
Special protections for religious and linguistic minorities.
हिंदी: अल्पसंख्यक अधिकार
examples: Minority Rights are guaranteed by Articles 29–30.

cards.def:
The right of all adult citizens to vote.
हिंदी: सार्वभौमिक मताधिकार
examples: Universal Suffrage gives every adult a vote.
Universal Suffrage ensures equal political voice.

cards.def:
The body that drafted the Constitution.
हिंदी: संविधान सभा
examples: The Constituent Assembly drafted the Constitution.
The Constituent Assembly debated for nearly three years.
The Constituent Assembly included eminent leaders.
The Constituent Assembly adopted the Constitution in 1949.

cards.def:
The day the Constitution came into force.
हिंदी: गणतंत्र दिवस
examples: Republic Day is celebrated on 26 January.
Republic Day marks the Constitution's adoption.

cards.def:
Membership in a state with rights and duties.
हिंदी: नागरिकता
examples: Citizenship can be acquired by birth or naturalization.
Citizenship binds individuals to the nation.

cards.def:
Adherence to the spirit and values of the Constitution.
हिंदी: संवैधानिक नैतिकता

A formal written order issued by a court.
हिंदी: रिट / न्यायादेश
examples: Habeas Corpus is a writ against illegal detention.
Writs are issued by higher courts.

cards.def:
A writ requiring a detained person to be brought before a court.
हिंदी: बंदी प्रत्यक्षीकरण
examples: Habeas Corpus protects against illegal detention.
Habeas Corpus can be filed by anyone.
Habeas Corpus is a powerful remedy.

cards.def:
A writ ordering a public authority to perform its duty.
हिंदी: परमादेश
examples: Mandamus is issued when duty is refused.

cards.def:
A writ transferring a case from a lower court for review.
हिंदी: उत्प्रेषण-लेख

A writ questioning a person's authority to hold office.
हिंदी: अधिकार-पृच्छा
examples: Quo Warranto is issued against usurpers.

cards.def:
A temporary law issued by the executive when legislature is not in session.
हिंदी: अध्यादेश
examples: An Ordinance has the force of law.
Ordinances must be approved by Parliament.

cards.def:
A bill dealing only with taxation and government spending.
हिंदी: धन विधेयक
examples: A Money Bill is introduced only in Lok Sabha.
A Money Bill needs the Speaker's certification.
A Money Bill cannot be amended by Rajya Sabha.
A Money Bill concerns taxes and spending.

cards.def:
A motion expressing lack of confidence in the government.
हिंदी: अविश्वास प्रस्ताव
examples: A No-Confidence Motion can topple a government.
A No-Confidence Motion is moved in Lok Sabha.

cards.def:
A formal process to remove a high official for misconduct.
हिंदी: महाभियोग
examples: Impeachment removes the President for violation.

cards.def:
Conflict over powers between Centre and States.
हिंदी: संघीय विवाद
examples: Federalism Dispute is resolved by courts.

cards.def:
The right of a region or institution to govern itself.
हिंदी: स्वायत्तता
examples: Autonomy is guaranteed for some regions.

cards.def:
An institution created by the Constitution.
हिंदी: संवैधानिक निकाय
examples: The Election Commission is a Constitutional Body.
Constitutional Bodies derive power from the Constitution.
Constitutional Bodies ensure checks and balances.

cards.def:
An institution created by an Act of Parliament.
हिंदी: वैधानिक निकाय
examples: A Statutory Body is created by law.
Statutory Bodies can be modified by Parliament.
Statutory Bodies are accountable to legislature.

cards.def:
A global statement of basic human rights adopted in 1948.
हिंदी: मानवाधिकारों की सार्वभौमिक घोषणा
examples: The Universal Declaration of Human Rights inspires constitutions.
The Universal Declaration of Human Rights affirms dignity.
The Universal Declaration of Human Rights guides international law.
The Universal Declaration of Human Rights protects freedoms.

cards.def:
Basic rights belonging to every person by virtue of being human.
हिंदी: मानवाधिकार
examples: Human Rights are universal and inalienable.
Human Rights are enforced by courts.

cards.def:
The procedure for changing the Constitution.
हिंदी: संविधान संशोधन प्रक्रिया
examples: The Constitutional Amendment Process varies by provision.
The Constitutional Amendment Process needs special majority.
The Constitutional Amendment Process balances rigidity and flexibility.
The Constitutional Amendment Process protects federalism.

cards.def:
Formal approval of a constitutional amendment or treaty.
हिंदी: अनुसमर्थन
examples: Ratification requires state approval for some amendments.

cards.def:
The belief that government power should be limited by law.
हिंदी: संविधानवाद

Brotherhood and solidarity among citizens.
हिंदी: बंधुत्व
